proposed_label: Private equity ownership: employment, productivity and real effects
status: AI-assisted analyst proposal; pending reviewer approval
rationale: Employment, labor and job terms accompany citation-central studies of jobs, productivity, restaurant operations and growth buyouts. The membership also covers disclosure, innovation and stakeholder effects.

proposed_label: Leveraged buyouts: financing, governance and value creation
status: AI-assisted analyst proposal; pending reviewer approval
rationale: LBOs, management buyouts, debt, takeovers and going-private terms accompany central studies of operating performance, buyout structure and value creation.
review_caveat: Broad buyout community with heterogeneous financing, governance, employment and exit studies. Representative excerpts can include retained references or tables; consult full membership and source passages.

proposed_label: Venture capital and private equity: entrepreneurial finance and institutions
status: AI-assisted analyst proposal; pending reviewer approval
rationale: Entrepreneurs, entrepreneurial activity, venture capitalists and contracting distinguish a mixed community whose central papers cover disclosure, the VC/PE literature and fund inflows; member titles also cover institutions and emerging markets.
review_caveat: Mixed and relatively small community (29 works), including surveys and cross-country work. Entrepreneurial finance is an umbrella proposal rather than a claim of thematic homogeneity.

proposed_label: Private equity funds: performance, risk and investor decisions
status: AI-assisted analyst proposal; pending reviewer approval
rationale: PME, vintage, IRR, LPs and GPs distinguish fund performance and investor decisions, with central papers on returns, persistence and limited-partner performance.
review_caveat: Includes venture capital, infrastructure, real estate and impact investing; the common focus is fund/investor economics, not one asset subtype.

proposed_label: Private equity in healthcare: ownership, costs and quality
status: AI-assisted analyst proposal; pending reviewer approval
rationale: Hospital, patient, physician, Medicare and nursing terms align with the systematic review, care-delivery and nursing-home representatives, and healthcare ownership studies throughout the membership.
review_caveat: Includes a broader private-equity book review (P159) and multiple care settings. Citation membership does not imply common findings about costs or quality.
